purpose: external acceptance instrument for the ProgressDesk core delivery
criteria: an observed fix reaches every affected target without a per-project approval, a repeated application is not duplicated, and a recorded supersession replaces the lesser fix
a failed application is visible and terminal and does not silently continue
research produces a visible unsigned VISP draft with provenance that the owner can read, dismiss or approve, and it cannot authorize its own execution
a within-contract lesson changes the intended instruction or its version, not only a model reply
the recorded usage is available and a completed phase can be replayed into a deterministic baseline without inventing performance targets
